title: Pinterest Trends Input
description: Collect public Pinterest trending searches, keyword history and supporting trend content by market.

region.title: Region
region.description: Pinterest Trends market. Combined codes such as `GB+IE` cover Pinterest's published regional groups.
enumTitles: Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Guatemala + Peru
Cyprus, Czechia, Greece, Hungary, Malta, Poland, Romania + Slovakia

lookbackWindow.title: Lookback window
lookbackWindow.description: Comparison window used by Pinterest for trending searches (mode=trendingSearches).

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Historical end date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Leave empty for Pinterest's latest available date (mode=trendingSearches, keywordResearch, shoppingCategories, shoppingMetrics).

interest.title: Interest category
interest.description: Pinterest interest filter for trending searches (mode=trendingSearches).

moment.title: Seasonal moment
moment.description: Pinterest seasonal moment filter for trending searches (mode=trendingSearches).

keywordsToInclude.title: Include keywords
keywordsToInclude.description: Only keep trending searches containing at least one of these words (mode=trendingSearches).

keywordsToExclude.title: Exclude keywords
keywordsToExclude.description: Drop trending searches containing any of these words (mode=trendingSearches).

ageGroup.title: Audience age
ageGroup.description: Pinterest audience age filter for trending searches and keyword research.

gender.title: Audience gender
gender.description: Pinterest audience gender filter for trending searches and keyword research.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Terms to research (mode=keywordResearch). Leave empty to use Pinterest's current top trending searches.

days.title: History window
days.description: History length in days for keyword research and shopping metrics.

predictedDays.title: Forecast days
predictedDays.description: Pinterest forecast horizon. Forecasts are published for the US only (mode=keywordResearch, shoppingMetrics).

includeRelated.title: Include related terms
includeRelated.description: Add Pinterest's related terms and their weekly history for each keyword (mode=keywordResearch).

includeAudience.title: Include audience demographics
includeAudience.description: Add age and gender distributions for each keyword (mode=keywordResearch).

includeImages.title: Include images
includeImages.description: Add a representative Pinterest image for each keyword (mode=keywordResearch).

includeSuggestions.title: Include search suggestions
includeSuggestions.description: Add Pinterest search suggestions for each keyword (mode=keywordResearch).

shoppingEvent.title: Shopping signal
shoppingEvent.description: Pinterest shopping signal used for category metrics and ranked shopping trends.

includeTopCategories.title: Include ranked shopping categories
includeTopCategories.description: Add Pinterest's fastest-growing shopping categories with related searches (mode=shoppingCategories).

categoryNames.title: Shopping category names
categoryNames.description: Exact Pinterest shopping category names for metrics, such as `Sofas` or `Wedding dress` (mode=shoppingMetrics). Leave empty to use Pinterest's featured level-2 categories.

maxItems.title: Maximum records
maxItems.description: Maximum records to return. Trending lists are partitioned by interest to go beyond Pinterest's 100-term list ceiling.
